Opus 5.5 vs GPT 6 astra

tested both with the same prompt at their highest reasoning settings, using the same devin harness:

> opus took 2 hours 10 mins and cost $75 
> astra took 1 hour 25 mins and cost $61 

opus 5.5 attention to details is on point, it took time to make everything perfect as i wanted

but still super slow and ended up costing way more then astra

which one did better here?
用了真的香！使用Opus5.5做了一个小孩学习英语的口语小游戏，结合实时语音识别还是很不错，可以锻炼小孩子的英语口语。画面也很可爱，全程使用Opus 5.5生成。 https://t.co/vyrtFYfGjd

We gave 4 models the same prompt: build a lava lamp.

Claude Opus 5.5: $1.27, 9m 35s
GPT-6 Astra: $0.63, 5m 4s
GPT-6 Sol: $0.08, 50s
GPT-6 Luna: <$0.01, 43s

Which one did the best? https://t.co/TmNsEu2Ec7
Or its because I'm sitting on a banked reset, just waiting for the my usage to reset tomorrow... and I don't find GPT-6 Sol/Luna worth using when i can just use Astra.

the bulk of my use is still CC. Opus 5.5 is good indeed but I haven't seen a model perform as well as Astra with this kind of code. I woke up today to a major mess by opus. It's quite difficult to make it not assume bugs aren't in foundational parts of the library. It wasted the night and a lot of tokens on made up "issues" and absurd fixes even with explicit steering in a skill. The harness also plays an important role, though. CC's compaction is pretty bad and often derails the agent
而且 Opus 5.5 的用量，好像也比 Astra 消耗的慢。当然不排除这是因为我用 Opus 习惯了 medium 而用 Astra 6 很多时候是 high ... 被频繁的重置给惯坏了
GPT-6 Luna より GPT-5.6 Luna の方がなんか体感良いような
用 Opus 5.5 自己的动画能力，做了个狭义相对论的讲解科普视频。稿件有可改进之处，但是动画能力真的让人赞叹😄👍 观看地址：https://t.co/4AOkY2ffNU https://t.co/45T8LqFuhu

Opus 5.5 works best on 'low' reasoning effort.

I ran some tests as part of a project I'm working on. Opus 5.5 on 'low' reasoning vs. 'max' was at parity on task completion but 12x lower cost!

Set 'low' reasoning effort by default and increase it for the hardest problems.

Claude Opus 5.5 feels like GPT-5.6 Sol back them... Unlimited usage, fast and efficient.

Didn't like Opus 5 at all as many others.

I don't use Fable 5.1 much anymore. Opus 5.5 is the goat.

Gpt-6 Luna and Sol are useless to me... They don't get the job done as well as Astra for complicated things AND are still as slow so I don't use it much.

Gpt-6 Astra xhigh is awesome

@AnthropicAI @OpenAI
GPT-6 Solたまにアホなこと言い出すが、Astraをそんな時は呼び出すしかない

自从我用上 Claude Opus 5.5 之后，终于知道什么是真正的人工智能了

我让它做了一个鹈鹕骑车竞速比赛，需求：

“三只鹈鹕沿着海岸比赛，每条赛道有虚线，我控制其中一只，按空格加速，还要支持侧视角和后视角”

直接超预期完成，鹈鹕、赛车、围巾、海岸、镜头和整体氛围，都像属于同一个游戏世界。它不是简单把功能拼起来，而是在理解一个作品应该具备什么感觉

直接视频看效果

Opus 5.5 真是达到了一个新高度，牛逼！就算封号我也用！！！

由于opus 5.5实在太贵，为了省钱我早上选择用 grok 4.7 开发一个流程，他陪伴我一个上午又一个下午，到了晚上还是跑不通。虽然每一次花的不多但一天下来也得几千万tokens。

晚上实在无力继续，我还是换回了 opus 5.5，终于安静了，虽然又花了10💲但是酸爽！ https://t.co/NlfjfbxipC
@hany99dev - I’ve been using Opus 5.5, and gpt 6 sol is much more efficient so the combo didn’t run out of limits now! I might ditch mg second OpenAI account.

新模型剛出的時候就開始試用也用了幾天了，心得如下

- opus-5.5 相比 opus-5 進步極大根本是隔代升級相當有感，不會一直停下來而且訊息更短好理解

- gpt-6-sol 沒感受到太進步，就像是比較聽話的 gpt-5.6-sol 中間不會停下來

- grok-4.7 拉一坨大的，做事只會拉屎

我宣布模型订阅性价比新王诞生了

claude 20刀订阅，用opus 5.5 high，中高强度使用才会触及到5小时limit，并且模型足够聪明，足够快

现在codex像小丑了，就算是GPT-6-Astra 20X订阅，都无法给我带来相同的喜悦

GPT-6 Sol 我实测了两天，给大家一个忠告！

它的能力远不如 GPT-5.6 Sol，它仅仅只是 GPT-5.6 Terra 的升级版，基本可以确定就是一个小参数模型，难怪价格也跟原来的 GPT-5.6 Terra 差不多。

我猜测运行 GPT-5.6 Sol 的算力需求较大，远不如把算力挪给 GPT-6 Astra 使用。因此着急忙慌的，还要把原来的 GPT-5.6 Sol 下线了。
用gpt 6 luna跑了一个40小时的任务，同时还在用bot 沟通，大概消耗了一半的周额度。满周额度24小时连轴跑能干3天。很知足了。 https://t.co/tLxYoMzPwS

First impressions of GPT-6 Sol

I've run it on several of my projects, and I already have plenty to say. «GPT. GPT never changes»

1. Tunnel vision and getting endlessly stuck on a single task? Check ✔

2. Disgusting code that turns your whole project into a mess? Check ✔

3. Zero understanding of what tests are or how to write them, plus tweaking the tests to fit its own bugs? Check ✔

4. Can't deliver a result on the first try without errors? Check ✔

5. Every new change introduces a pile of regressions? Check ✔

6. Text that's painful to read? Check.
7. The intelligence of a boiled shrimp? Check ✔

8. Zero emotional intelligence and a poor grasp of intent? Check ✔

9. Overengineering and needless complexity? Check ✔

10. Can't break its work into logical multi-step chains? Check ✔

11. Can't anticipate consequences?
Check ✔

Conclusion

GPT-6 Sol is the same classic GPT model with exactly the same problems, except this time they somehow managed to make it even worse. It's GPT-5.5 Mini, GPT-5.6-Flash Sol, GPT-5.6-Light. Call it whatever you want, but it's definitely not GPT-6. It's the worst frontier model I've ever used. It's bad at everything. It's even worse than 5.6

For some reason, OpenAI decided that a lower price would be enough to win people over. It's painfully dumb and gets stuck on tasks like no model before it. You constantly have to ask it to redo things. You waste a ton of time, iterations, and energy. In the end, it costs more than Opus 5.5

I work at a large corporation with 5,000 people. My employer pays for our Claude, Codex, Qwen, and Kimi subscriptions. I don't know a single engineer at the company who hasn't run into every problem I listed. People simply don't enjoy working with GPT models. They don't want to trust them with their code or with serious tasks. Until OpenAI recognizes and fixes this, they'll never earn recognition in the professional community. Their models will stay stuck doing Computer Use and other routine grunt work

GPT 6 Astra 挖的坑，终于可以让 Opus 5.5 给填上了

GPT 6 ： 不说人话、降智、编程能力倒退 300 年。

今天总算用上 Opus 5.5 了，喜极而泣。

再也不想被 Tibo 的重置大法当猴耍了。 https://t.co/4dFhBhmXq9
